description: The chart illustrates token counts split into two components—“Reasoning” and “Demonstration”—for five category indices, shown as stacked vertical bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 in ascending order, with no explicit axis title. The vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, with regularly spaced tick marks at 1000-token intervals; a gray dashed horizontal reference line appears near 6400 tokens. Each bar is stacked with an orange “Reasoning” segment on the bottom and a blue “Demonstration” segment on top, as indicated by the legend at the top center. Category 0 shows only an orange bar labeled 6393 (no visible blue segment). Category 1 has an orange segment around 4250 tokens with a small blue cap bringing the total to roughly 4450, and a red downward arrow annotation labeled “-1952” above it. Category 2 has an orange segment around 4500 with a blue cap to about 4750 total, annotated with a red “-1613.” Category 3 has an orange segment near 5000 with a blue cap to roughly 5350 total, annotated “-1040.” Category 4 has an orange segment around 4250 with a larger blue cap to about 5000 total, annotated “-1379.” The bars are not visually sorted by height beyond the natural left-to-right category order, and the red arrow annotations and the single numeric label “6393” on the first bar are the primary visual emphases.
